name: Ganbare! Mithra-jin
source:
4th century AD, Ancient Rome...
Mithraism, an esoteric religion originating in the Orient and worshiping the sun god Mithra, is threatened by the cult of a new god.
With the survival of the secret rites at stake, the god rises up.
Seek out the faithful, battle the presence of heresy, and restore the lost faith! 

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9547]Novelgame[/url]]
